summary: Connect gender analysis, policy options, budgets and indicators in a practical five-day course. Explore the outline and assess its fit for your role.
lede: Gender mainstreaming training in public policy helps policy analysts, programme leads and budget specialists assess how decisions affect different groups. Participants use the Harvard Analytical Framework and Moser Gender Planning Framework to analyse gender roles and resource access, compare policy options, and connect actions to budgets and measurable indicators. Exercises cover impact screening, expenditure tracking and accountability planning to support policy review and implementation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who shape, assess, fund or monitor public policies and need to connect gender analysis with practical policy decisions.
modules: Gender Mainstreaming in the Policy Cycle
OECD DAC Gender Equality Policy Marker
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public policy development, programme planning or public budgeting is expected. Coding is not required; exercises use Excel for sample expenditure and monitoring tables.
